content.value: Design a waste stabilization pond system to treat waste water from a lowincome settlement with a population of 20,000 at khalishpur Khulna. The average waste water flow is about 110 liters per person per day and the BOD contribution is35gm/person/day. The mean temperature of the coolest month is $2 0 ^ { 0 }$ c and during irrigation season, $2 5 ^ { 0 } \mathrm { c } .$ It is described that the final effluent be used for crop irrigation. Assume, faecal coliform concentration in raw wastewater to be $1 \mathrm { x } 1 0 ^ { 8 }$ per 100 ml and permissible $\mathrm { F c } \leq 1 0 0 0 / 1 0 0$ ml. volumetric loading rate at $2 0 \%$ is 320 gm/m³/day and BOD removal at $2 0 \%$ is 60%. BOD surface loading rate at $2 0 \%$ is 255 kg/ha/day and at $2 5 \%$ is 350 kg/ha/day.
Khulna Universityof Engineering&Technology Department of Architecture
